mods.description: A handy mod for chest marking and decoration that lets you apply images of any item from your hand directly onto block surfaces with a single click!

releases.notes: Introduce utility classes and constants for chalk/display handling (ChalkHelper, ModConstants) and add a unified FrameItem. Refactor ChalkItem to centralize placement/removal logic (useChalk), handle hand priority, support background layers, glow/dye interactions, and proper client/server behavior. Update Iconic mod initializer to use ChalkHelper/ModConstants, add discard effects, periodic validation and block-break cleanup for displays, and prioritize chalk interactions over normal block use. Consolidate per-color frame assets into a single tintable frame model/texture and register a single FRAME item in ModItems. Misc: add IconicClient doc comment and update language files and fabric.mod.json.
